fichas.title: Loft Windows
fichas.summary: Loft window size is determined by the desired quality of living and applicable requirements. The page states that living-room window area should be at least one-eighth of the floor area. Windows may be grouped horizontally or vertically using flashing. Wider living-room windows can be created with rafter trimmers and additional rafters; steeper roofs need shorter windows and flatter roofs longer ones. Diagrams show opening types, installation heights, installation details, and window sizes related to floor area.
